# Image prompting for Nano Banana and GPT Image 2.5

Curated by Skill Harbor — @smixs's image-prompting skill for Nano Banana (NB2/NBP) and GPT Image 2.5 (Flare/Sunburst): it refuses to write prompts from the thin skill body alone and enforces a mandatory reading order — a model chooser, one model-specific reference (image grounding and extreme aspect ratios for Nano Banana; the 5-slot template and anti-slop banned words for GPT Image 2.5), universal golden rules, then task-shaped references (text rendering, editing, character continuity, de-slop photorealism, slides). A sibling `video` skill handles motion.
